title: Pure Mist Spearmint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Spearmint captures the cool and refreshing taste of classic Spearmint with a subtle sweetness, making it a perfect choice for vapers seeking a light and invigorating minty flavour. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers tailored VG/PG ratios to suit different vaping preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Spearmint is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
